basics.name: Vatsal Trivedi
basics.label: Principal Engineer · AI Platforms · Enterprise Integrations
basics.summary: I build AI platforms, multi-tenant SaaS, and the integrations companies actually run them on. At Phamax I lead engineering for Ariya, a pharma AI platform for content, research, analytics, and engagement. That includes the compliance path and the Veeva CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud connections. I also ship small tools in the open. The current one is openpreflight: GitHub Check Runs on a server you already run.

work.name: Phamax
work.description: Ariya is an AI platform for pharma: content generation, research, analytics, and engagement.
work.summary: Lead engineering for Ariya, an AI platform for pharmaceutical content, research, analytics, and engagement. The work is to design and ship systems that put generative AI into the tools pharma teams already use, without skipping compliance.
highlights: Architect the core systems for an AI platform used by global pharmaceutical clients. Workflows cover content creation, research, analytics, and engagement.
Built the AI Content Wizard and the content lifecycle around it: authoring, multi-stage approval, compliance checks, and distribution in regulated markets.
Designed and shipped LLM orchestration (prompts, context injection, RAG, embeddings, tool calling) so generated content stays compliant and traceable across content types and markets.
Integrated Veeva CRM and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) so omnichannel campaigns can run across client tenants without breaking compliance.
Led the Data Catalog so business and engineering teams can find data from metadata, with observability and self-serve access.
Shipped audit trails, deployment pipelines, and monitoring, and sped up AI and data workflows with caching and vector databases.

work.name: Comviva
work.description: MobiLytix Rewards and MobiLytix Digital Marketing Product
work.summary: Technical lead for MobiLytix Rewards, an engagement product for loyalty programs and promotional campaigns.
highlights: Led the rewrite of MobiLytix Rewards into a cloud-agnostic, multi-tenant SaaS product, with AI/ML personalization, for telecom and retail clients.
Owned full-stack architecture and features in TypeScript, React, FeathersJS, Delta Lake, Postgres, and vector databases, on a distributed microservices system.
Owned the Kafka campaign pipeline for high-throughput reward and loyalty workflows, with async processing and caching.
Introduced observability and monitoring across the platform. Deploys got more reliable and production incidents took less time to resolve.
Improved user engagement and campaign performance with personalization and ML segmentation.

work.name: Comviva
work.summary: Built integrations and analytics for an omnichannel marketing automation platform used to reach customers across digital channels.
highlights: Shipped 14+ integrations including Shopify Public App, Seatgeek, HubSpot, AWS QuickSight, GoodData, Matomo, WooCommerce, WordPress, Batch Push, and Unlayer Editor.
Built ML insights on Google BigQuery and GoodData for campaign optimization.
Improved performance with query work, caching, and CDNs.
Worked through multi-tenant data isolation, API rate limits, and how credentials are stored for third-party platforms.

Set up Microsoft 365 workflows with SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, and Power BI.
Built analytics and reporting with GA360, Google Tag Manager, and Data Studio for life sciences teams.

projects.name: openpreflight
projects.description: Self-hosted GitHub Check Runs for private pull requests. One Go binary, one SQLite file, on a server you run. Apache-2.0.
highlights: GitHub App, webhooks, runner, UI, and local state in one deployable unit. Docker Compose or a Linux release binary.
The project checks itself: docs, site, and the binary each get a Check Run from ci.openpreflight.xyz. GitHub Actions is only used to publish release images.
Wrote a five-part series on vatsal.xyz, from the trigger model through running untrusted code.

projects.name: Knock
projects.description: Copy-paste React and Tailwind components for private previews: access screens, invitations, and draft controls. Drops into a shadcn project.

projects.name: InboxCraft
projects.description: A browser-only PowerShell generator for Microsoft 365 Outlook inbox rules. Quick and Advanced modes, with templates for GitHub, Slack, and Jira. Scripts stay in the browser.

projects.name: InboxCraft Skills
projects.description: Official Agent Skills pack for InboxCraft. Nine PowerShell tools so assistants can manage Outlook rules, folders, and categories from a prompt.
highlights: Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and other assistants that follow the npx skills spec.
Covers rule creation, folder trees, categories, large-folder scans, and empty-folder cleanup.

projects.name: audit-plan-tasks
projects.description: Agent Skill that scaffolds AUDIT.md, PLAN.md, and TASKS.md so a plan is based on what you actually checked, not on the request.
highlights: Audit first: read the code, run the commands, hit the real endpoints, then plan.
Install with npx skills add trivedi-vatsal/audit-plan-tasks.

projects.name: StaleGuard
projects.description: Reloads a stale SPA when the tab is focused again, by checking ETag and Last-Modified. No polling and no banner.

projects.name: PySecRecipes
projects.description: GitHub Actions recipes that audit Python dependencies against PyPI, OSV, and Python Packaging advisories, and open or close issues as findings change.

projects.name: PyImportSync
projects.description: AST check that every Python import is declared in requirements.txt. Ships as a GitHub Action and a pre-commit hook.
